import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',

    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,

})

# Data: (judge, axis, bt, ci_lo, ci_hi, p_str, significant)
# Ordered by judge group, then axis within group
data = {
    ("GPT-4o", "Formality"):          (0.630, 0.558, 0.703, "<0.001",  True),

    ("GPT-4o", "Register"):           (0.570, 0.489, 0.649, "0.038",   True),
    ("Qwen3-32B", "Formality"):       (0.665, 0.585, 0.739, "<0.0001", True),
    ("Qwen3-32B", "Verbosity"):       (0.773, 0.703, 0.843, "<0.0001", True),
    ("Qwen3-32B", "Register"):        (0.553, 0.473, 0.630, "0.092",   False),
    ("Llama-3.3-70B", "Formality"):   (0.695, 0.618, 0.765, "0.0001",  True),
    ("Llama-3.3-70B", "Verbosity"):   (0.735, 0.660, 0.805, "0.0001",  True),
    ("Llama-3.3-70B", "Register"):    (0.635, 0.555, 0.712, "0.0014",  True),
    ("Gemini-2.5-Flash", "Formality"):(0.574, 0.500, 0.642, "0.0306",  True),
    ("Gemini-2.5-Flash", "Verbosity"):(0.708, 0.637, 0.772, "<0.0001", True),
}

colors = {
    'Verbosity': '#D55E00',
    'Formality': '#0072B2',
    'Register':  '#009E73',
}

judge_order = ["GPT-4o", "Qwen3-32B", "Llama-3.3-70B", "Gemini-2.5-Flash"]
axis_order  = ["Verbosity", "Formality", "Register"]
GROUP_GAP = 0.7

# Build rows top-to-bottom, assign y positions bottom-up
rows = []
for judge in judge_order:
    for axis in axis_order:
        key = (judge, axis)
        entry = data.get(key)
        rows.append((judge, axis, entry))

n = len(rows)
y_positions = []
y = n + (len(judge_order) - 1) * GROUP_GAP
for i, (judge, axis, entry) in enumerate(rows):
    if i > 0 and rows[i][0] != rows[i-1][0]:
        y -= GROUP_GAP
    y_positions.append(y)
    y -= 1.0

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5.2))

# Judge group shading
for j_idx, judge in enumerate(judge_order):
    group_ys = [y_positions[i] for i in range(len(rows)) if rows[i][0] == judge]
    if j_idx % 2 == 0:
        ax.axhspan(min(group_ys) - 0.45, max(group_ys) + 0.45,
                   color='#f5f5f5', zorder=0)

# Plot data points and labels
for i, (judge, axis, entry) in enumerate(rows):
    yp = y_positions[i]
    color = colors[axis]

    if entry is None:
        ax.text(0.65, yp, '—', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=11, color='#aaaaaa')
        ax.text(0.395, yp, axis, ha='right', va='center', fontsize=10, color='#aaaaaa')
    else:
        bt, ci_lo, ci_hi, pval, sig = entry
        ax.plot([ci_lo, ci_hi], [yp, yp], color=color, linewidth=1.8,
                solid_capstyle='butt', zorder=2)
        ax.scatter(bt, yp, marker='D', s=70,
                   color=color if sig else 'white',
                   edgecolors=color, linewidths=1.5, zorder=3)
        ax.text(0.395, yp, axis, ha='right', va='center', fontsize=10)

        p_str = f"p{pval}" if pval.startswith("<") else f"p={pval}"
        stat_text = f"{bt:.3f}  [{ci_lo:.3f}, {ci_hi:.3f}]  {p_str}"
        ax.text(0.91, yp, stat_text, ha='left', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
                fontfamily='DejaVu Sans Mono')

# Judge group labels (bold, left of axis labels)
for judge in judge_order:
    group_ys = [y_positions[i] for i in range(len(rows)) if rows[i][0] == judge]
    mid_y = np.mean(group_ys)
    ax.text(0.28, mid_y, judge, ha='right', va='center', fontsize=10.5, fontweight='bold')

# Reference line
ax.axvline(x=0.5, color='#888888', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, zorder=1)
ax.text(0.5, min(y_positions) - 0.8, 'No preference', ha='center', va='top',
        fontsize=9, color='#888888')

ax.set_xlim(0.4, 0.9)
ax.set_ylim(min(y_positions) - 0.9, max(y_positions) + 0.6)
ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("P(style-preferred wins)")
ax.spines['left'].set_visible(False)

# Legend
legend_elements = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='D', color='w', markerfacecolor='grey',
           markeredgecolor='grey', markersize=8, label='Significant (p<0.05)'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='D', color='w', markerfacecolor='white',
           markeredgecolor='grey', markersize=8, label='Not significant'),
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower right', frameon=False, fontsize=9)

import os
out_dir = '/root/causal_style_decomp_judge/artifacts/figures/paper'
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/forest_plot.pdf')
fig.savefig(f'{out_dir}/forest_plot.png')
plt.close()
print(f"Saved: {out_dir}/forest_plot.pdf")
